prompts.q01: Recherche sur le web les informations officielles NASA sur Europa Clipper : date reelle du lancement, mois et annee prevus pour son insertion orbitale a destination, et planete que la sonde doit alors orbiter. prompts.q08: Pour les nouveaux appareils rechargeables par cable mis sur le marche dans Union europeenne, recherche sur le web quel port commun est exige, depuis quelle date pour les smartphones et depuis quelle date pour les ordinateurs portables. limits: Ten short factual questions, mostly historical; not deep research or a universal benchmark.
One run per model/question, no provider retries. End-to-end application/network/provider; cache and provider thinking settings not isolated.
Main paired latency comparison excludes Q01 for every model after first Gemini measurement failure; nine paired questions, approximately1.7s sampling.
Addresses and app rendering inspected; actual phone clicks are not automatically inferred. Search invocation and actual billed cost not independently measured.
Official source support may come from an accessible page or explicitly identified official index text; inaccessible pages are not labelled false.
Raw screenshots and device network details stay local; reported model identity comes from application footer, not an independent server trace.
